title: trace.linked event data
description: One typed link of the trace chain (Phase 2 section 9.2): source, relation, target. Trace links are the single source of truth for the chain; records never hold link lists. Milestone 3 relations are verified_by (AC to TC) and mitigated_by (RSK to TC); the rest of the chain's relations are named here so later events need no new vocabulary. source and target carry no pattern because a target may be a test id (classname::name).
